description: Prisma raw SQL ($queryRaw / $executeRaw / *Unsafe) — verify parameterization and source of inputs

patterns.label: $queryRaw called as function (not tagged template) — verify parameterization
$executeRaw called as function (not tagged template) — verify parameterization
$queryRaw template with interpolation — verify Prisma.raw isn't mixed in
$executeRaw template with interpolation — verify Prisma.raw isn't mixed in
Prisma.raw — bypasses parameterization, must not include user input

examples: await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe(`SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '${name}'`);
await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = " + id);
await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ${name}`;
notes: Gate: deepsec tech [prisma]; kalkan uses tech node (or prisma) and a manifest that names prisma.
